details.fix_explanation: Moved all secrets from hardcoded literals to environment variables. Added validation to ensure all required secrets are present at startup. This prevents credential exposure in version control and source code repositories.

Added URL validation against allowlist of trusted domains (ALLOWED_NOTIFY_DOMAINS). Removed sensitive PAYMENT_TOKEN from outbound requests. Added timeout and SSL verification. This prevents attackers from redirecting requests to internal systems or extracting tokens.

details.fix_explanation: Replaced MD5 (cryptographically broken) with HMAC-SHA256. MD5 is vulnerable to collision attacks and rainbow tables. HMAC-SHA256 provides both integrity and authenticity for authentication tokens.

Added allowlist validation for file paths. Only whitelisted paths (e.g., /etc/config.yaml) are permitted. This prevents attackers from reading arbitrary files via path traversal or directory traversal attacks.

Disabled debug mode by default and made it controllable via FLASK_DEBUG environment variable. Added localhost-only binding (127.0.0.1). Debug mode exposes sensitive information and allows arbitrary code execution.
